description: This file defines the 'EmpDirectDebit' entity class for ORM mapping in a Human Resource Management System. It models direct debit information for employee salaries, including properties such as routing number, account details, amount, account type, and transaction type, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmpDirectDebit
classes.description: Entity class representing direct debit details for employee salary payments, mapped to 'hs_hr_emp_directdebit' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the direct debit record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the direct debit record.

methods.name: setSalary
methods.description: Associates an EmployeeSalary entity with this direct debit record.

methods.name: getRoutingNumber
methods.description: Gets the bank routing number for the direct debit.

methods.name: setRoutingNumber
methods.description: Sets the bank routing number for the direct debit.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Returns the account details associated with this direct debit.

methods.name: setAccount
methods.description: Sets the account details associated with this direct debit.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Gets the amount to be debited.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount to be debited.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the type of account (e.g., savings, checking).
